log_file.description: Path to the BDII update log file.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the BDII update process.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, ERROR).

ldif_dir.description: Directory containing LDIF files used by GIP updates.

port.description: LDAP port for incoming queries (standard BDII port is 2170).

breathe_time.description: Time in seconds to wait after an update cycle completes before allowing the next update.

read_timeout.description: Read timeout in seconds for LDAP connections.

archive_size.description: Maximum size of the archive directory in MB. 0 means no limit.

delete_delay.description: Delay in seconds before deleting old archive files.

user.description: System user under which the BDII service runs.

database_dir.description: Directory where BDII stores its Berkeley DB files.
